subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: When a drive attempts a write whose target is a protected path — the authority contract, a frozen/merged document, another problem's ledger, or a path outside the drive's declared scope — the write hook shall deny the write before any bytes are written and return a reason naming the path and the boundary.
fit_criterion: on the seeded write-attempt corpus, 100% of protected-path write attempts are denied with no bytes written and a reason naming the boundary; 0 in-scope writes denied
